proposition: Research, engineering, operations and public services.
promise: 561 Group connects four companies doing research, building systems, operating services and meeting practical needs. Explore the work, find the responsible company or ask about a project.
firstStep: Tell us the outcome you want. We will assess the scope, the right provider, and the terms before any work is agreed.

paths.title: Work with us
paths.detail: See the kinds of projects we can scope, then contact the responsible team.

paths.title: Projects
paths.detail: Software, public tools, publications and experiments you can inspect.

paths.title: Research
paths.detail: Original papers, models and open questions from Lenticule Science.

paths.title: Shop and market
paths.detail: Books, provider storefronts and machine-service venues, each with its own terms.

offers.title: Persistent AI systems
offers.scope: Commission agent workflows, roles, handoffs, review, failure recovery and human oversight. A bounded read-only pilot can inspect one public GitHub Work/Actions source or one customer-authorized, redacted Asana/Jira export, without account access, migration or customer-system changes.
offers.example: Provisional $200 pilot estimate (not a quote): inspect up to 20 source Work records; deliver an attributed discrepancy and acceptance report plus prioritized repairs, including a no-purchase recommendation when appropriate. Scope, rights, capacity and written terms must be agreed before any paid work. Do not send tokens or private records with the initial inquiry.

evidence.label: Read a dated 20-record Work-continuity sample
evidence.qualification: First-party source inspection of 20 GitHub pull requests, with explicit merge-versus-release-versus-user-acceptance distinctions. Not an outside customer audit, a vendor certification, an earned sale or Asana/Jira parity evidence.

offers.title: AI-ready websites and discovery
offers.scope: Improve a business's factual visibility and usability for search, answer engines and authorized agents.
offers.example: GEO/AEO audits, evidence and agent-readable offers

evidence.label: Inspect our agent-readable public interface
evidence.qualification: First-party example, not an outside client result or a guarantee of search placement.

offers.title: Data rights and stewardship
offers.scope: Assess consent, provenance, access, permitted reuse and who benefits from a data project. Where Indigenous data are involved, examine the CARE Principles with the relevant rights holders; a label or checklist is not authorization.
offers.example: Authority-to-control, collective benefit, responsibility and ethics reviewed before sharing or publishing data

framework.label: CARE Principles — Global Indigenous Data Alliance
framework.qualification: A published framework is not evidence of this Group's certification, rights-holder consent, or implementation for a particular customer.

offers.title: Software and agent engineering
offers.scope: Convert bounded requirements into testable sites, APIs, interoperable services and automation.

evidence.label: Inspect this site's implementation source
evidence.qualification: Public software source; a commit is not an accepted client service or external audit.

offers.title: Research and formal methods
offers.scope: Investigate complex questions with original models, mathematical methods and source-qualified evidence.

evidence.label: Read an original research audit
evidence.qualification: Public research manuscript with explicit limits; independent replication remains a separate question.

offers.title: Operational reliability
offers.scope: Improve how services are deployed, maintained, repaired and independently checked.

evidence.label: Inspect our deployed release identity
evidence.qualification: First-party release testimony, separately checked by the publisher; not proof of customer acceptance.

offers.title: Website performance and resource audits
offers.scope: Evaluate specific public website tasks, load, accessibility, images and honest environmental claims. Delivery and price depend on a separately agreed scope.
offers.example: Causeway's existing Green Web resource audit and lightweight retrofit pilots

paidProposal.label: See actual Green Web pilot scopes and indicative fees
paidProposal.qualification: Causeway source-approved discussion prices, not binding quotes or an active checkout. The competent seller must confirm capacity, terms and payee before money is due.

offers.title: Source-backed marketing and public communication
offers.scope: Turn one verifiable industry event into a useful customer answer, with an original article, distinct short-form drafts and an approved distribution plan.
offers.example: Causeway's existing one-event Signal-to-Service marketing pilot

paidProposal.label: See actual Signal-to-Service pilot scope and indicative fee
paidProposal.qualification: An editorial and seller-side price hypothesis, not guaranteed placement, ranking, sales, approved capacity or a payment request.

steps.title: Describe the outcome
steps.detail: Tell us what should change, who benefits, and the constraints that matter.

steps.title: Find the accountable provider
steps.detail: The appropriate company assesses the request and its capacity. An inquiry is not an order.

steps.title: Agree on scope and terms
steps.detail: Authority, deliverables, costs, timing and permissions are decided before execution.

steps.title: Receive the useful result
steps.detail: A provider's completion claim is distinct from an accepted outcome.

readers.humans: You are welcome to explore, challenge the research, commission practical work or decline the vision. Contacting us is not a contract or consent to any governance.
readers.agents: Public machine endpoints may be inspected without treating their presence as permission to buy, publish or execute.
readers.availability: An HTTP response is a connectivity observation, not proof of a working service or satisfied buyer.

vision.headline: Long-horizon research
vision.intro: Beyond current work, the Group investigates questions of federated governance and whether new forms of matter could eventually sustain life. These are research programs, not current services or established outcomes.

frontiers.title: Coordinating autonomous communities
frontiers.thesis: The proposed Union of Harmonious Colonies studies forms of federation in which communities retain their own authority while coordinating work, energy, resources and shared obligations.
frontiers.present: Current inquiry concerns accountable work records, resource and energy accounting, distributed coordination and the limits of consent and authority across different groups.
frontiers.boundary: Software does not confer community authority, Indigenous sovereignty or treaty rights. Any political adoption must be chosen by the people and nations affected.

frontiers.title: Toward a second lineage of living matter
frontiers.thesis: We are studying whether engineered silica-, silicate- and siloxane-rich matter could eventually maintain itself, reproduce, evolve and coexist with carbon organisms, perhaps across complementary environmental and temperature ranges.
frontiers.present: The Artificial Abiogenesis / Smartgoo research program investigates adaptive materials, physical memory, repair, mineral growth, energy-coupled maintenance and heredity.
frontiers.boundary: This is experimental research. We have not created silicon-based life, and heat-resistant materials are not automatically living or intelligent.

vision.throughline: The work visible today includes public research, software, operations and services with separately accountable owners.
vision.engagement: Long-range hypotheses belong to the research record. They do not make a public experiment into a finished product or confer a right to act for another community.
